== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Mount Venture is one of the four [[holy peaks]] that border the [[Sacred Valley]], situated to the west. It is characterized by its rust-red cliffs and a distinct mineral composition that makes it the primary site for mining within the valley. The [[Kazan clan]] and the [[Golden Sword School]] share control over this territory, splitting the profits generated from its resources. The mountain's most significant exports include Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel blades, [[halfsilver]] ingots, and sky-Iron{{!}}iron statuettes. During a period of intense conflict, the mountain was destroyed when it was cracked open like a shell, revealing a golden treasure within. Following its [[destruction]], the remains of the peak continued to emit yellow light after a [[Titan]] fed upon its core.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located to the west, Mount Venture was once a sacred, squat peak characterized by its red-tinged color. This location was defined by its surrounding distant peaks, but its status changed drastically as events unfolded. [[Lindon]] eventually questioned whether the mountain remained intact, only to discover that it had been completely destroyed. The once-sacred site was ultimately left in ruins.}}
